We are currently looking for candidates with deep specialization in tensor mathematics for our AI team. We are building an advanced AI research team working on mathematical AI, tensor-based computation, and next-generation machine intelligence. We are interested in hiring exceptional M.Sc., Ph.D., and Postdoctoral researchers specializing in Theoretical Physics, Mathematical Physics, General Relativity, Tensor Calculus, Differential Geometry, and related mathematical disciplines. We would appreciate an opportunity to circulate our job description among eligible students and researchers and to discuss campus hiring opportunities.

AI Research Engineer – Tensor Mathematics & Spatial AI
We are looking for exceptional M.Tech, M.S. (Research), Ph.D., or final-year postgraduate students from IIT Delhi with a strong foundation in advanced mathematics for next-generation AI research.
Preferred Background
• Tensor Algebra & Multi-linear Algebra
• Tensor Decompositions (CP, Tucker, Tensor-Train)
• Differential Geometry & Riemannian Manifolds
• Scientific Computing / High-Performance Computing
• PyTorch or CUDA-based optimization (preferred)
What they’ll Work On
• Build advanced AI models for large-scale spatial-temporal systems.
• Design high-performance tensor computation frameworks.
• Optimize AI algorithms for GPU acceleration and real-world deployment.
Who Should Apply
Students from Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, AI, Computational Engineering, or related disciplines with strong mathematical and research-oriented problem-solving skills. My objective is to hire M.Sc. and Ph.D. graduates with deep expertise in tensor calculus, differential geometry, theoretical physics, and advanced mathematical physics,
If anybody is passionate about applying advanced mathematics to solve real-world AI challenges, we would love to connect with them.
data.additional_details: In addition to this, we are open to considering two R&D professionals who have completed their graduation with extensive academic exposure to tensor mathematics, or candidates holding a Ph.D. in a relevant field.
